text:
Contact your pediatrician right away. A fever that high for two days plus unusual sleepiness needs a medical assessment — I can't advise on dosing, and those symptoms together warrant a professional look.

When you call, have Mira's weight handy (pediatricians dose by weight, not age), and mention how long the fever's been and that she's unusually drowsy.

If you can't reach your regular office, an urgent care or nurse hotline can help you right now.
